decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits close to the core offer and had its own page, and the firm is still expanding, so it most likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.

Shuttering magnet blocks are a low-cost consumable in the core precast formwork business and complement the firm's integrated systems, so slack and growth favour keeping them despite their limited visibility.
Magnetic formwork strips had their own page and fit the established magnetic formwork range, so they likely perform at or above aspiration and carry no trigger for withdrawal.

This component overlaps with the similar Product E, which the firm already pruned, and it was only mentioned online, which raises the risk of consolidation, but without evidence of a shortfall the expanding firm will probably keep it in the range.
